facts.text: The resort sits on 450 acres of desert gardens.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on 450 acres of lush desert gardens

facts.text: The resort's lakes are home to swans and pink flamingos.
facts.excerpt: tranquil lakes — home to swans and the famous JW pink flamingos

facts.text: Guided boat tours through the resort's waterways depart from the lobby.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a serene and guided boat tour through our picturesque waterways, conveniently departing from the lobby.

facts.text: Desert Springs Golf Club has two championship courses, the Palm and the Valley, designed by Ted Robinson.
facts.excerpt: Designed by course architect Ted Robinson, Desert Springs Golf Club features two championship golf courses - the Palm and the Valley

facts.text: The resort has an 18-hole natural turf putting course with bunkers, lakes, streams and waterfalls.
facts.excerpt: our 18-hole all-natural turf putting course is complete with contoured fairways, bunkers, lakes, streams, and waterfalls.

facts.text: The tennis facility has hard, clay and grass courts.
facts.excerpt: featuring a variety of hard, clay, and grass courts.

facts.text: The resort's tennis program is run by Peter Burwash International for every skill level.
facts.excerpt: our comprehensive Peter Burwash International (PBI) tennis program has something for every skill level.

facts.text: Spa Desert Springs is a 38,000-square-foot facility with an Aromatherapy Hammam Steam Chamber.
facts.excerpt: Spa Desert Springs features a luxurious 38,000 square-foot facility with an Aromatherapy Hammam Steam Chamber

facts.text: The spa has an outdoor saltwater lap pool and a coed Wellness Lounge.
facts.excerpt: an outdoor saltwater lap pool, and a Coed Wellness Lounge.

facts.text: The spa's VIP Sanctuary Spa Suite is staffed by a personal butler and has a private entrance and a hydrotherapy tub in a private courtyard.
facts.excerpt: The 600-square-foot VIP suite is staffed by a personal butler and includes a private entrance, a hydrotherapy tub in a private courtyard, and another tub indoors.

facts.text: Spa treatments use essential oils, aromatherapy and CBD-infused therapies.
facts.excerpt: treatments that harness the latest in essential oils, aromatherapy, and CBD-infused therapies

facts.text: Rooms feature plush bedding, hardwood floors, modern furnishings and mountain-inspired murals in blue, gray and white.
facts.excerpt: Accommodations feature plush bedding, hardwood floors, modern furnishings, and mountain-inspired murals in hues of blue, gray, and crisp white.

facts.text: Bathrooms have quartz vanities.
facts.excerpt: Spa-like bathrooms feature quartz vanities

facts.text: The Vice Presidential Suite has views of the Santa Rosa Mountains and the Coachella Valley.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the breathtaking views of the Santa Rosa Mountains and surrounding Coachella Valley from our Vice Presidential luxury accommodations

facts.text: The JW Garden is an aromatic garden of herbs used in the hotel's culinary program.
facts.excerpt: the JW Garden is a meditative, aromatic garden that features herbs that are staples of the hotel's culinary program.

facts.text: The JW Entertainment Zone is an arcade with new and retro games and duckpin bowling.
facts.excerpt: The JW Entertainment Zone is a 12,000 sq. ft. arcade featuring new and retro arcade games, duckpin bowling

facts.text: The resort has five outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: five outdoor pools

facts.text: The Oasis Pool is kept at 84 degrees year round.
facts.excerpt: Oasis Pool is kept at a perfect 84 degrees year round.

facts.text: Frank Sinatra's last public performance took place at the resort.
facts.excerpt: Frank Sinatra's last public performance took place at the Resort?

facts.text: The resort has ten dining outlets, from casual poolside bites to five-course tasting menus.
facts.excerpt: Our ten resort dining outlets deliver a variety of unique culinary experiences, from casual poolside bites to elaborate five-course tasting menus.

facts.text: Rockwood Grill has water views from its patio.
facts.excerpt: offers amazing water views from its patio

facts.text: The resort is minutes from Acrisure Arena, the Living Desert Zoo & Garden and the Indian Wells Tennis Garden.
facts.excerpt: The resort is minutes from Acrisure Arena, the Living Desert Zoo & Garden, the Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival, and the Indian Wells Tennis Garden.

facts.text: An 18-hole mini-golf course is surrounded by palm trees and pink flamingos.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by swaying palm trees and pink flamingos, enjoy some whimsy with our 18-hole mini-golf course.

facts.text: JW family programming includes movie nights and art projects.
facts.excerpt: With a variety of programs, including Movie Night, Sweet Weekend Delights, art projects and more

facts.text: A daily resort fee applies and covers amenities such as range access, mini golf, bike rental and court time.
facts.excerpt: The following amenities are available to you to enjoy as our guest and are included in the daily Resort Fee

facts.text: The Spa Bistro is available only to guests who purchase a treatment or Spa Day Pass.
facts.excerpt: Spa Bistro is available to guests who purchase a treatment or Spa Day Pass.

facts.text: Spa services require an appointment.
facts.excerpt: Appointment required

facts.text: Palm Springs International Airport is about 12 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: PSP is located approximately 12.2 Miles from the hotel.

facts.text: Dogs are the only pets welcome at the property.
facts.excerpt: Dogs are welcome at our property only.
